tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel. The hologram floats on it.

tokens.name: hull
tokens.usage: Panel surface (Panel, DecisionCard, VitalReadout).

tokens.name: hull-raised
tokens.usage: Raised rows inside a panel: selected crew, hovered list rows, segmented control track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and decorative panel brackets. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and gauge tracks; 3:1 on hull and void in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and readout numerals on void, hull and hull-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, timestamps, provenance on void, hull and hull-raised (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: holo
tokens.usage: The hologram: body wireframe, sparkline strokes, focus ring, selected state, links. Text-safe on void and hull.

tokens.name: holo-wash
tokens.usage: Fill inside the body silhouette and behind a selected row. Decorative only.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Suit orange. The one primary action per view and the AstroHealth mark. Never a status.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: tier-green
tokens.usage: Tier GREEN: nominal. Always beside its check icon and the word; text-safe on hull.

tokens.name: tier-yellow
tokens.usage: Tier YELLOW: watch. Triangle icon and word; text-safe on hull.

tokens.name: tier-red
tokens.usage: Tier RED: act now. Octagon icon and word; text-safe on hull. Green and red differ by under 3:1 in lightness at night, so the icon and word are mandatory.

tokens.name: tier-grey
tokens.usage: Tier GREY: insufficient data. Dashed ring icon and the word; never shown as nominal.

tokens.name: tier-green-wash
tokens.usage: Badge and card tint behind GREEN content.

tokens.name: tier-yellow-wash
tokens.usage: Badge and card tint behind YELLOW content.

tokens.name: tier-red-wash
tokens.usage: Badge and card tint behind RED content.

tokens.name: tier-grey-wash
tokens.usage: Badge and card tint behind GREY content.

tokens.name: sim
tokens.usage: SIMULATED data label only (hatched chip). Never used for status or brand.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen: the overall crew state on the dashboard header.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: DecisionCard headline, panel titles in a detail view.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Channel names, panel headers, badge words. Always uppercase.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: The value in a VitalReadout. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Values in body-map callouts, gauges and compact rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to word in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact rows and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value; button padding block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on dense dashboards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding in detail views; grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (gloved hands) and screen margins.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, sparkline band.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs (with a cut corner).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Hotspots, crew dots, the segmented control thumb.

tokens.name: glow-holo
tokens.usage: Selected hotspot and focused hologram parts. Glow at night, a crisp edge by day.

tokens.name: glow-alert
tokens.usage: A RED DecisionCard or hotspot only.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Every Panel.
